---
format:
  html:
    toc: true
    toc-expand: false
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrors: true
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ["nav#TOC ul[data-toc-expanded=\"-1\"]",
           "nav#TOC a.nav-link.active",
           "nav#TOC a.nav-link[data-scroll-target=\"#inner\"]"]
        - ["nav#TOC ul ul[data-toc-expanded]"]
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['<a href="#outer" class="nav-link active" data-scroll-target="#outer">']
        - ['href="#inner" class="nav-link active"']
---

bd-toc-scrollspy-js-41e624d8. `toc-expand: false` is Q1's `-1`: every
nested list starts collapsed. The attribute rides on the top-level list
only (one producer, `toc_render.rs`), and the first top-level link is
`active` at render time so the no-script page shows one current entry.
The regexes pin that; the live-DOM check only asks that some entry is
active (see toc-expand-default.qmd for why).
